doc: Class declarations of the data-layer rules on the facts side (docs/facts/PHASE-3.md § P3b; the rule files carry no `class`). Keyed `check/clause`; each entry admits a clause at `class`, names the stage and operator that set it (`facts-a explain --classes`) and why the rule keeps that shape. A declared clause compiles and runs under its algebraic budget; an unbounded clause without an entry is warned about by the census and EXPLAIN, and listed by the gate's class-residue check.
